Rami Rahim (ex-Juniper CEO) now runs all of HPE Networking; integration past planning phase, into execution (confirmed at MWC Barcelona 2026). Expected >=$600M cost synergies by FY28, requiring ~$800M investment. Discover 2026 showcased first unified AI networking stack (Marvis self-driving AI + Aruba Central; Mist LEM <-> Aruba Agentic Mesh cross-pollination).
